overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action, finding the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by meeting in executive session for an improper purpose at two January 6 meetings, and ordered compliance and release of those minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board improperly met in executive session at two January 6 meetings, including to consider and interview applicants after a prior screening.
allegations.key_passage: The Board acknowledges, and we find, that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by meeting in executive session for an improper purpose during each of two meetings held on January 6.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Release minutes of the January 6 executive sessions within 30 days of the letter, if not already done, and certify to the AG that it has done so.
remedy_passage: We further order the Board to release minutes of the January 6 executive sessions that are the subject of the Open Meeting Law complaint within 30 days of this letter if it has not done so already, and to certify to this office that it has done so.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
